name: vigilia-web
description: Frontend workspace: shared renderer, display-only player and editor.

scripts.gate: biome check .. && npm run gates:self-test && npm run test
scripts.//gate: The one command that means green (D1's ruling, 2026-10-12: biome check, not format:check + lint, because organizeImports is an assist only check runs). `gates:self-test` is exhaustive for `scripts/*.mjs` -- every script with a self-test is chained there rather than excluded, sdd-checkpoint.mjs's `--self-check` included even though `hooks:check` also reaches it. The unit suite is in the chain because the gate list carried no test run at all and a task closed with `vitest run` red (vg-323).
scripts.gates:self-test: node ../../scripts/check-status.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/reuse-gate.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-sweep.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-overlap.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/backlog-check.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/design-tokens.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/design-md.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/dead-code-sweep.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-enforcement.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/sdd-checkpoint.mjs --self-check

//devDependencies: jsdom and canvas are the `*.dom.test.ts` environment, declared here beside vitest because vitest.config.ts owns `environment` for the whole workspace. They were reachable without being declared — both are OPTIONAL dependencies of fabric@7.4.0 — which is the problem: `canvas` is native, npm continues silently when its prebuild is unavailable, and the tests that need a real 2D context would then lose it without failing. Declaring them also puts them through CI's licence job.
